comment.body:
Would it be cleaner for startup failure details to live on `Publisher` itself?

Since all concrete phone/microcontroller publishers extend `Publisher`, it seems natural for the publisher to own both its lifecycle state and its last startup failure/error. Right now `Publisher` has `PublisherState`, but failure details are tracked separately through manager/registry startup metadata.

That makes the lifecycle harder to inspect because the publisher can be in `FAILED`, but the associated failure reason lives elsewhere. Could `Publisher` hold its own startup failure details, with `PublisherManager` aggregating publisher states/failures rather than maintaining parallel failure metadata?
